subject: Re: Heat map status: first results + cost risk
body:
Team,

Decisions from the review with Hana:

1. Flagship list is capped at three classifiers for the August readout. The long tail moves to Q4.
2. Freya's mid-frequency finding on the large model is the headline — please turn it into a one-pager with the heat maps.
3. Ingestion: we are tracking to the Jul 17 target Alina set against the Jul 24 corpus freeze; Katya confirmed the final perturbed sets go in this week.

Readout is Aug 6, 30 minutes. I will circulate the deck by Aug 3 for comments.

Thanks — this is shaping into the strongest robustness story in the portfolio.

Lucia
